description: Create a reward a brand can give members: a coupon code, a link or a message. Milestone rewards set in the dashboard are perks too.

brandId.description: Brand ID, the project that offers the perk.

expiresAt.description: When the perk stops being shown, as an ISO 8601 time.

kind.description: coupon (a code), url (a link) or message (text).

name.description: What the brand calls this perk.

uniqueCodes.description: Coupons only. true when each member needs their own code, like a gift card: members wait for one until codes are added, and never get the value.

validDays.description: How many days a member has to use it after it's given, like 30. Null keeps it until the perk's own expiry.

value.description: The coupon code, link or message.

valueCents.description: What the perk is worth to a member, in cents.

name: create_perk
title: Create a perk
